description: Report mode: how every live CitySignal city is doing, in one call. The CitySignal Index for the last complete week (Sunday to Saturday): each city scored against its own typical week (Quiet, Typical, Busy, Heavy, with how many times typical), per category (roads, water, power, construction, transit), the biggest departure, week over week, plus what is live in each city right now. Use for reporters and anyone asking 'how is everything across cities', 'which city had the roughest week', 'compare Atlanta and Dallas this week'. Compare cities only by how far each is from its own typical week, never by raw counts: what each city publishes differs. Say when a city is Counting (not scored yet) or a category is Not covered. Cite it as the CitySignal Index and give index_url.

mode.description: summary (default): the storylines and one line per city, for a quick read. detailed: every city's categories too, for a reporter writing it up. trend: each city's recent weekly totals, oldest first, for 'is this getting worse'.
